name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
title: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd - 543374 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Asset manager with flows still below market growth; Q4 equity yield fell 2-3 bps and PAT dropped to ₹187 crore on lower other income, while management claims flows are improving from a low base.

triggers.label: Equity yield down 2-3 bps QoQ
triggers.quote: there is a good around 2 - 3 basis point yield reduction which would have happened this quart er

triggers.label: Market share fall narrowing
triggers.quote: the overall reduction is a very , very marginal, narrowed quite significantly

triggers.label: TER cut from 1 April, impact 3-4 bps
triggers.quote: the broad impact generally post the regulatory changes is in the range of about 3 to 4 basis points, roughly

triggers.label: SIP cancellations up in volatility
triggers.quote: It used to be somewhere around about 45% to 50% for the industry I'm talking about. It went up to almost about 92% for the industry.

guidance.value: Reasonably close to market growth momentum very soon
guidance.quote: With the improved flows , broadly I would say , we should come reasonably close to the market growth momentum very soon.
the Board has proposed a dividend of ₹25.5 per share

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT down on lower other income
red_flags.quote: Our Q4 FY26 profit after tax was at ₹187 crores as compared to ₹228 crores.

red_flags.label: Market share still declining
red_flags.quote: we will continue to focus on reducing the fall in the market share before we start rising

evasions.topic: Net impact of TER/regulatory change on AMC P&L
evasions.quote: we have not quantified any kind of exact number
So, there is no specific reason.
